summary: Reload stale tabs after a model restart and make project Q&A automatically use the newest saved terminal analysis instead of the browser's Analysis Run selection.
decision_refs: User report on 2026-09-27 that a replacement API key could not be entered/restarted and manual Analysis Run selection made project Q&A too cumbersome
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested both workflow simplifications and a fix.
known_limitations: Newly uploaded files are not silently included until the user starts an analysis update.
Project questions remain independent requests rather than a persistent multi-turn conversation.
